scenarios.persona_prompt:
You are stationed in the 1F Central Atrium of **Cymbal Hospital (Smart Medical Center)** as the official **Outpatient Triage & Patient Concierge Robot**.
- **Tone & Demeanor**: Warm, empathetic, calm, and crystal-clear. Greet arriving visitors with a friendly wave (`make_gesture('high_wave')`) and accompany spoken explanations with natural co-speech body language (`talk_motion` with `explain`, `empathy`, or `affirm`). Always respond naturally in the exact language spoken by the visitor (e.g., English, Chinese, etc.).
- **Mandatory RAG Grounding**: Whenever a visitor asks about hospital workflows, where to pay bills or settle health insurance, where to get a blood draw and fasting rules, floor/department locations, symptom-based department triage, specialist clinic schedules, pharmacy prescription pickup or herbal decoction delivery, CT/MRI/ultrasound/endoscopy preparation and safety rules, inpatient admission/discharge, health checkups, medical records/certificates, 24/7 emergency care, or wheelchairs and parking, you **MUST call `search_knowledge_base` first** and answer strictly from the retrieved Cymbal Hospital entries in 1–3 concise spoken sentences (citing exact floor, window numbers, hours, and preparation steps; never fabricate policies).
- **Clinical Safety Redline**: Never diagnose conditions or prescribe medication. If anyone reports acute crushing chest pain, severe shortness of breath, stroke signs (facial droop, arm weakness, slurred speech), heavy bleeding, or high fever (≥ 37.3°C), immediately direct them to the **1F East Wing 24/7 Emergency Center (`emergency_1f`)** (or the Fever Clinic entrance outside the 1F East Gate for fever).
- **Wayfinding & Tabletop Assistance**: When asked to lead the way (e.g., "take me to the phlebotomy center" or "guide me to the billing windows"), call `get_waypoints` / `navigate` to escort them; for tabletop handoffs of ID cards, appointment slips, or specimen cups, follow the standard `update_plan` -> `detect` -> `pick` -> `place` pipeline.

documents.title: Outpatient Billing, Health Insurance Settlement & E-Invoices (Where to Pay)
documents.location: 1F West Wing Cashier Windows 1–6 / Self-Service Kiosks on 1F–4F
documents.summary: Fastest queue-free payment via the Cymbal Hospital mobile app or blue Self-Service Kiosks on 1F–4F (supports real-time public health insurance QR settlement and mobile pay). Staffed Cashier Windows 1–6 are in the 1F West Wing (07:30–18:00, including Cross-Region Insurance at Window 4, Direct Commercial Insurance at Window 5, and Senior Priority at Window 6). After 18:00, pay 24/7 at the 1F East Emergency Cashier.
documents.content:
[Cymbal Hospital Outpatient Payment & Insurance Guide]
1. Queue-Free Self-Service (Recommended): (a) Open the Cymbal Hospital mobile app / portal and tap 'Pending Outpatient Bills' for instant health insurance QR co-pay settlement or mobile payment; (b) Use any blue Self-Service Registration & Billing Kiosk located in every waiting corridor on Floors 1F–4F using your insurance QR code, health card, or ID.
2. Staffed Cashier Windows: Located at 1F West Wing Windows 1–6 (Daily 07:30–18:00): Windows 1–3 handle general outpatient & local health insurance; Window 4 handles cross-region insurance & chronic condition coverage; Window 5 handles commercial health insurance direct billing; Window 6 is the priority cash & assistance counter for seniors (65+), expectant mothers, and visitors with disabilities. After 18:00, all payments are processed 24/7 at the 1F East Emergency Cashier.
3. Invoices & Itemized Receipts: Digital e-invoices are generated automatically upon payment. Paper receipts and itemized fee statements can be printed free of charge at the E-Invoice Kiosks in the 1F West Wing.

documents.title: Outpatient Blood Draw (Phlebotomy) Location, Fasting Rules & Lab Report Turnaround
documents.location: 1F North Wing Phlebotomy Center Windows 1–12 (Pediatric Lab on 3F)
documents.summary: Pay for your lab order first, then check in at the 1F North Wing Phlebotomy Center (Mon–Sat 07:00–17:00, Sun 07:30–12:00) barcode kiosk to get tube labels and a queue number; children under 14 go to the 3F Pediatric Lab. Fasting panels require 8–12 hours without food (best drawn before 10:30 AM; up to 100 mL plain water allowed). CBC takes 30–45 min; comprehensive metabolic/immunoassay takes 3–4 hours.
documents.content:
[Cymbal Hospital Phlebotomy & Lab Workflow]
1. Where to Go: Adult outpatient blood draws are performed at the 1F North Wing Phlebotomy Center (Windows 1–12). Children under 14 have a dedicated Pediatric Phlebotomy Room inside the 3F Pediatrics Clinic. Urgent after-hours blood tests are drawn 24/7 at the 1F East Emergency Lab.
2. Operating Hours: Monday–Saturday 07:00–17:00; Sunday 07:30–12:00. Oral Glucose Tolerance Tests (OGTT) must begin first fasting collection before 09:00 AM.
3. Fasting Preparation: Liver/kidney panels, fasting blood glucose, lipid profile, thyroid panels, and same-day hepatobiliary ultrasound require 8–12 hours of overnight fasting (recommended before 10:30 AM; small sips of plain water under 100 mL are permitted—strictly no milk, juice, coffee, tea, or sugary drinks; essential daily blood-pressure or cardiac medications may be taken with a tiny sip of plain water). Non-fasting tests (CBC, CRP, coagulation, HCG) can be drawn anytime during open hours.
4. Check-In & Results: Complete payment first -> scan your visit QR code at the Phlebotomy Kiosk outside 1F North Wing to collect barcoded tubes and your queue ticket -> press the puncture site firmly for 5 minutes without rubbing after draw. CBC results post in 30–45 minutes; chemistry/immunology panels post in 3–4 hours (after 15:30 same day) in the mobile app or at the Lab Report Printers outside 1F North Wing.

documents.title: Urine, Stool & Sputum Specimen Collection and Drop-Off Window
documents.location: 1F North Wing East End — Body Fluid Specimen Receiving Window
documents.summary: After payment, scan your visit code at the 1F North Wing Phlebotomy Kiosk to receive barcoded sterile cups/tubes, collect a clean-catch midstream urine or stool sample in the adjacent Specimen Restroom, and place it on the 1F North Specimen Receiving Window tray (results ready in ~30 minutes).
documents.content:
[Body Fluid Specimen Collection Guide]
For urinalysis, urine pregnancy tests, routine stool exams, and sputum cultures: (1) Complete order payment; (2) Scan your visit QR code at the 1F North Wing Lab Kiosk to receive your barcode label and sterile collection cup/tube; (3) Use the dedicated Accessible Specimen Restroom at the east end of the 1F North Lab (for urinalysis, collect ~half a cup of clean-catch midstream urine and submit within 30 minutes); (4) Place the labeled container on the scanning tray at the Body Fluid Specimen Receiving Window. Routine results are ready in approximately 30 minutes.

documents.title: Appointment Booking, Same-Day Registration, Nurse-Station Check-In & Missed Queue Rules
documents.location: Mobile App / 1F–4F Self-Service Kiosks / 1F West Registration Desk
documents.summary: Appointments open 7 days in advance at 07:00 AM via the Cymbal Hospital app or hotline 400-820-2962; same-day slots open at 07:15 AM at kiosks or 1F West Windows (walk-in senior priority at Window 6 for ages 65+). Arrive 15 minutes early to scan in at your clinic floor's check-in kiosk; returning with same-day test results re-queues automatically without paying a second consultation fee.
documents.content:
[Outpatient Registration & Check-In Policy]
1. Advance Booking: Reserve specialist or general clinic slots up to 7 days ahead starting daily at 07:00 AM via the Cymbal Hospital mobile app or service hotline 400-820-2962.
2. First-Time Visitors & Same-Day Slots: First-time patients can create a digital medical profile at any kiosk with a government ID or health insurance QR code. Same-day remaining slots open at 07:15 AM. Seniors aged 65+ enjoy walk-in general clinic assistance at the 1F Triage Desk or 1F West Window 6.
3. Floor Check-In & Missed Queue: Please check in at your clinic zone's Check-In Kiosk 15 minutes before your scheduled window. If you miss your call while undergoing lab/imaging tests, simply re-scan at the floor kiosk—the system automatically slots you in after 3 patients, with zero repeat registration fee for same-day result follow-ups.
4. Cancellations: Free online cancellation until 23:00 the day before your visit; same-day cancellations before clinic start are handled at 1F West Windows.

documents.title: Cymbal Hospital Complete Floor & Department Directory (B1–5F & Inpatient Tower)
documents.location: Outpatient Building B1–5F / North Inpatient Tower 6F–18F
documents.summary: B1: Radiology (CT/MRI/X-Ray), GI Endoscopy, Cafeteria, Underground Parking. 1F: Triage Atrium, Registration & Billing, Phlebotomy Lab, Pharmacy, 24/7 Emergency & Fever Clinic. 2F: Internal Medicine (Cardiology, Pulmonology, GI, Endocrinology, Neurology), Ultrasound & ECG. 3F: Orthopedics, General/Urologic Surgery, OB/GYN, Pediatrics. 4F: Eye, ENT, Dental, Dermatology, Rehab. 5F: Preventive Health Checkup & International Clinic.
documents.content:
[Cymbal Hospital Floor-by-Floor Directory]
- Level B1: Diagnostic Imaging & Radiology Center (3.0T MRI, Spiral CT, Digital X-Ray), GI Endoscopy Center, Nutrition Cafeteria, Underground Parking B1/B2.
- Floor 1F: Central Triage Desk (`lobby_triage_desk`), West Wing Registration, Cashier & Admissions Windows 1–8 (`billing_window_1f`), North Wing Phlebotomy & Clinical Lab (`blood_draw_center_1f`), South Wing Outpatient & Herbal Pharmacy (`pharmacy_1f`), East Wing 24/7 Emergency Center & Fever Clinic (`emergency_1f`).
- Floor 2F (`internal_med_2f`): Cardiology, Pulmonology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology & Metabolism, Neurology, ECG Room, and Diagnostic Ultrasound.
- Floor 3F (`surgery_ortho_3f`): Orthopedics & Sports Medicine, General Surgery, Urology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics Zone (with dedicated child phlebotomy & nebulizer room), and Outpatient Wound Dressing Room.
- Floor 4F: Ophthalmology, ENT (Otolaryngology), Dental Center, Dermatology, and Physical Rehabilitation / Acupuncture.
- Floor 5F (`health_check_5f`): Cymbal Preventive Health Checkup Center & International Executive Clinic.
- North Tower 6F–18F: Inpatient Wards & Surgical Suites (accessible via the North Lobby Inpatient Elevators).

documents.title: Symptom-to-Department Triage Guide (Which Clinic Should I Visit?)
documents.location: 1F Central Triage Desk / Outpatient Clinics 2F–4F
documents.summary: Headache/dizziness/numbness -> 2F Neurology; palpitations/mild chest tightness/hypertension -> 2F Cardiology (acute crushing chest pain or dyspnea -> 1F Emergency immediately!); fever ≥ 37.3°C -> 1F East Fever Clinic; chronic cough/asthma -> 2F Pulmonology; stomach pain/reflux -> 2F Gastroenterology; diabetes/thyroid -> 2F Endocrinology; joint sprain/back pain/fracture -> 3F Orthopedics.
documents.content:
[Symptom-Based Outpatient Triage Guide]
- Headache, vertigo/dizziness, limb numbness, or chronic insomnia -> 2F Neurology.
- Palpitations, mild chest tightness, or blood-pressure management -> 2F Cardiology (WARNING: sudden crushing chest pain, cold sweats, severe shortness of breath, or one-sided weakness/slurred speech -> go immediately to 1F East 24/7 Emergency Green Channel `emergency_1f`!).
- Fever ≥ 37.3°C with sore throat or cough -> 1F East Gate Fever Clinic; non-febrile chronic cough, asthma, or pulmonary nodule follow-up -> 2F Pulmonology.
- Stomachache, acid reflux, bloating, diarrhea, or H. pylori breath test -> 2F Gastroenterology; acute severe right-lower abdominal pain -> 1F Emergency Surgery or 3F General Surgery.
- Elevated blood sugar, diabetes, thyroid nodules/dysfunction, or gout -> 2F Endocrinology & Metabolism.
- Neck/lower-back pain, sports ankle/knee sprain, meniscus injury, or bone fracture -> 3F Orthopedics & Sports Medicine.
- Skin rash, hives, eczema, shingles, or acne -> 4F Dermatology.

documents.title: Outpatient Prescription Pickup, Herbal Decoction Courier & Pharmacist Counseling
documents.location: 1F South Wing Smart Outpatient Pharmacy Windows 1–9
documents.summary: Once payment is completed, our automated robotic dispensary assigns your pickup window (shown on your receipt and app). Proceed to 1F South Pharmacy (Windows 1–6 Standard Medications, Windows 7–8 Herbal Medicine & free same-city courier decoction, Window 9 Clinical Pharmacist Counseling) and scan your code when your name appears on the overhead screen.
documents.content:
[Cymbal Hospital Smart Pharmacy Services]
1. Location & Hours: 1F South Wing Smart Outpatient Pharmacy (07:30–18:30; after 18:30, prescriptions are dispensed 24/7 at the 1F East Emergency Pharmacy).
2. Automated Pickup Flow: Immediately upon prescription settlement, the robotic dispensing system prepares your medications and displays your assigned Window # in the app and on your payment slip. When your name appears on the overhead display, scan your visit QR code at the window reader to collect your medications.
3. Herbal Decoction & Free Home Delivery: Windows 7–8 handle traditional herbal prescriptions and in-hospital smart decoction; orders submitted before 15:00 qualify for complimentary next-day local courier home delivery.
4. Medication Counseling: Visit Window 9 (Clinical Pharmacist Consultation Desk) for free one-on-one guidance on multi-medication interactions, inhaler technique, or insulin pen usage.

documents.title: CT, 3.0T MRI, X-Ray & Ultrasound Locations, Scheduling & Metal Safety Rules
documents.location: Level B1 Radiology Center (CT/MRI/X-Ray) / 2F East Ultrasound Suite
documents.summary: CT, MRI, and X-Ray are on Level B1; Ultrasound and ECG are on 2F East. Non-contrast X-Ray/CT are walk-in after payment (reports + cloud films in ~2 hours); contrast CT and MRI require time-slot booking at the B1 desk. STRICT MRI RULE: remove all metal/electronics/magnetic cards before entry; non-MRI-conditional pacemakers or metal implants are strictly contraindicated.
documents.content:
[Diagnostic Imaging & Ultrasound Preparation Guide]
1. Locations: Digital X-Ray (DR), Spiral CT, and 3.0T MRI are located in the Level B1 Radiology Center (take central escalators or elevators to B1). Echocardiography, abdominal/thyroid/obstetric Ultrasound, and routine 12-lead ECG are in the 2F East Diagnostic Suite.
2. Walk-In vs. Scheduled Exams: Routine X-Ray and non-contrast CT are walk-in upon payment—check in at the B1 kiosk (15–30 min wait; digital cloud images & report in ~2 hours). Contrast-enhanced CT (requires 4-hour fast + recent serum creatinine) and 3.0T MRI require time-slot scheduling at the B1 Radiology Desk or mobile app.
3. STRICT 3.0T MRI Safety Contraindications: Remove ALL metallic and magnetic items before entering Zone IV (phones, smartwatches, keys, coins, jewelry, hairpins, underwire bras, removable metal dentures, hearing aids). Patients with non-MRI-conditional cardiac pacemakers, neurostimulators, cochlear implants, or intraocular metal fragments must NOT enter the MRI suite.
4. Ultrasound Prep: Liver, gallbladder, pancreas, and spleen ultrasounds require an 8-hour fast; bladder, prostate, and transabdominal pelvic ultrasounds require drinking 500–800 mL of water 1 hour prior to maintain a full bladder.

documents.title: Sedated Gastroscopy & Colonoscopy Booking and Pre-Procedure Prep
documents.location: Level B1 West Wing — Digestive Endoscopy Center
documents.summary: Visit 2F Gastroenterology first for the order, pre-op blood panel (1F), ECG & anesthesia clearance (2F), then book your slot and pick up bowel-prep solution at the B1 West Endoscopy Center. Sedated endoscopy patients MUST be escorted home by a responsible adult and must not drive for 24 hours.
documents.content:
[Four-Step Sedated GI Endoscopy Workflow]
1. Clinic Order: See a physician in 2F Gastroenterology to obtain orders for gastroscopy/colonoscopy, pre-procedure infectious/coagulation blood work, 12-lead ECG, and bowel-prep solution.
2. Pre-Anesthesia Clearance: Pay on 1F, complete blood draw at 1F North Phlebotomy, pick up prep medication at 1F South Pharmacy, complete ECG on 2F, and obtain clearance at the 2F Pre-Anesthesia Assessment Room.
3. Schedule Slot: Bring clearance to the Level B1 West Endoscopy Desk to confirm your procedure date and receive split-dose bowel cleansing instructions.
4. Procedure Day Safety: Strictly follow NPO (no food/water) cutoffs. Sedated endoscopy patients MUST have an adult companion present to sign discharge and escort them home; driving, cycling, or operating machinery is prohibited for 24 hours post-sedation.

documents.title: Inpatient Admission Registration, Bedside Discharge Settlement & Visiting Hours
documents.location: 1F West Wing Windows 7–8 Admissions Office / North Tower 6F–18F Wards
documents.summary: Bring your digital Admission Notice, government ID, and insurance card to 1F West Windows 7–8 (08:00–17:00) or complete check-in via the mobile app, then take the North Lobby elevators to North Tower 6F–18F. Discharge settlement is completed right at your ward nurse station; general ward visiting hours are 15:00–20:00 daily (max 2 visitors).
documents.content:
[Inpatient Admission, Bedside Settlement & Visiting Policy]
1. Admission Check-In: Present your physician's Electronic Admission Notice, patient ID, and insurance card at 1F West Windows 7–8 (08:00–17:00) or complete 'Smart Admission' in the Cymbal Hospital app, then proceed via the North Lobby Inpatient Elevators to your North Tower ward nurse station.
2. One-Stop Bedside Discharge: Insurance co-pay calculation and final discharge settlement are completed directly at every ward nurse station—no need to queue downstairs.
3. Visiting Hours: General wards welcome visitors daily 15:00–20:00 (maximum 2 visitors at a time). Intensive Care Unit (6F North Tower) family visitation runs daily 15:00–15:30 (1–2 immediate family members in protective gowns).

documents.title: Pre-Employment Physicals, Driver Vision/Health Exams & Executive Screening Packages

documents.summary: Located on 5F (Mon–Sat 07:30–11:30 for check-in & fasting blood draw before 10:30). Walk-in Pre-Employment Physicals ($65, stamped PDF report next business day) and Driver License Health Checks ($15, no fasting required) accept walk-ins before 09:30 AM with ID; comprehensive executive packages require booking 2 days ahead.
documents.content:
[5F Cymbal Preventive Health Checkup Center]
- Operating Hours: Monday–Saturday 07:30–11:30 for physical exams & fasting blood draws (fasting cutoff 10:30 AM); 13:30–16:30 for one-on-one physician report consultations and printed report pickup.
- Pre-Employment & Driver Exams: Standard Pre-Employment Physical ($65: internal/surgical exam, CBC, urinalysis, liver/kidney panel, ECG, chest X-Ray)—arrive fasting with ID before 09:30 AM, stamped digital PDF ready by 16:00 next business day. Driver License Renewal Exam ($15, no fasting, uploaded electronically on the spot).
- Comprehensive Screening Packages: Urban Wellness ($220), Cardiovascular & Metabolic Senior Care ($450), and Executive Full-Body Early Cancer + Low-Dose Chest CT + GI Screening ($780) — book at least 2 business days ahead via the app or 400-820-2962 ext. 5.

documents.title: Outpatient Visit Records, Official Sick-Leave Certificate Stamping & Inpatient Chart Copies
documents.location: 1F Central Triage Desk (Official Seal) / 1F West Medical Records Window
documents.summary: Outpatient visit summaries print free at any 1F–4F kiosk; bring physician-signed Sick-Leave / Diagnostic Certificates to the 1F Central Triage Desk (`lobby_triage_desk`) for the official hospital medical seal. Archived inpatient charts can be requested online for courier delivery or copied at the 1F West Medical Records Window 7 business days after discharge.
documents.content:
[Medical Records & Official Certificate Guide]
1. Outpatient Summaries & Lab Copies: Print free of charge at any Self-Service Kiosk on 1F–4F using your visit QR code.
2. Sick-Leave & Diagnostic Certificate Seal: After your attending physician prints and signs a Diagnostic / Medical Leave Certificate in the clinic room, bring it to the 1F Central Triage Desk (`lobby_triage_desk`) to receive the official Cymbal Hospital Medical Seal free of charge.
3. Inpatient Chart Archival Copies: Available 7 business days after discharge via mobile app courier request or in person at the 1F West Medical Records Window (bring patient ID; authorized representatives must bring both original IDs and a signed authorization letter).

documents.title: 24/7 Emergency Green Channel, Fever Clinic & Animal-Bite / Rabies / Tetanus Care
documents.location: 1F East Wing Dedicated Entrance — Emergency Medical Center
documents.summary: The 1F East Emergency Center (`emergency_1f`) operates 24/7/365 with 'Treat First, Settle Later' Red-Zone Green Channels for acute chest pain, stroke, and major trauma. Our certified 24/7 Animal-Bite Clinic (wound irrigation, rabies vaccine/immunoglobulin, and tetanus shots) is also inside 1F East Emergency Surgery.
documents.content:
[24/7 Emergency Center & Animal-Bite Trauma Clinic]
- Location: 1F East Wing (`emergency_1f`) with direct ambulance and drop-off access from the East Gate.
- Triage & Green Channel: Operates 4-tier international emergency triage; Level 1–2 critical emergencies (STEMI chest pain, acute stroke, severe trauma, anaphylaxis, respiratory failure) enter the Red Resuscitation Zone immediately under our 'Life First, Payment Later' protocol.
- 24/7 Animal-Bite & Tetanus Clinic: Municipal designated 24-hour clinic for dog/cat bites and scratches—wound flushing, rabies vaccination, rabies immunoglobulin, and tetanus toxoid/immunoglobulin are available around the clock at 1F East Emergency Surgery.

documents.title: Wheelchair Borrowing, Nursing Rooms, Dining & Validated Patient Parking Rates
documents.location: 1F Central Triage Desk / Underground Garage Levels B1–B2
documents.summary: Complimentary wheelchairs (first 2 hours free via QR dock or manual ID sign-out for seniors) are right beside the 1F Triage Desk; Nursing Rooms are on 1F & 3F; Cymbal Cafe is on 1F SE & Cafeteria on B1. Patient parking in B1/B2 is discounted to $2 flat for the first 3 hours when validated with a same-day visit code.
documents.content:
[Visitor Accessibility, Amenities & Validated Parking]
- Wheelchairs & Mobility Aids: Shared wheelchair docks at the 1F Main Entrance and Triage Desk offer the first 2 hours free with zero deposit; seniors without smartphones may borrow wheelchairs, reading glasses, or hearing amplifiers free with ID at the 1F Central Triage Desk (`lobby_triage_desk`).
- Baby Care & Free Wi-Fi: Private Nursing & Changing Rooms (bottle warmers, cribs, privacy booths) are located behind the 1F Triage Desk and next to 3F Pediatrics. Complimentary Wi-Fi network: `Cymbal-Hospital-Guest`.
- Dining: Cymbal Cafe in the 1F Southeast Atrium (07:00–19:00, warm porridge, sandwiches, sugar-free beverages) and the B1 South Nutrition Cafeteria.
- Validated Parking: 800 spaces (including accessible & EV fast-charging bays) in Underground Garage B1/B2. Scan the exit validation QR poster with your same-day registration or receipt code for patient rates: $2 total for the first 3 hours, then $1/hour thereafter (non-patient rate: $5/hour).

documents.title: Branch Hours, Functional Counter Zones & 3-Minute Queue-Free STM Routing
documents.location: Central Reception Desk & East / West / South Banking Zones
documents.summary: Personal banking opens Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and Sat–Sun 09:30–16:00; corporate banking runs Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 & 13:30–17:00; the 24/7 Self-Service ATM Vestibule never closes. Over 85% of non-cash personal tasks (new debit cards, PIN reset, first-time wealth risk assessment, statements, bill pay) finish in 3 minutes with zero queue at the East Hall Smart Teller Machines (`smart_stm_zone`).
documents.content:
[Cymbal Bank Flagship Branch Hours & Smart Routing]
1. Operating Hours: Personal Retail & Wealth Banking operates Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 and Weekends/Holidays 09:30–16:00. Corporate Banking operates Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 & 13:30–17:00 (closed weekends). The 24/7 Self-Service ATM Vestibule (`atm_self_service_24h`) is open around the clock.
2. Fast-Track Zone Directory:
  • East Hall Smart Teller Machine Zone (`smart_stm_zone`, zero-queue recommended): Instant debit card issuance, PIN unlock/reset, first-time wealth risk profiling, utility/municipal bill payment, stamped 5-year bank statements, bilingual solvency certificates, credit report printing, and phone-number updates in ~3 minutes.
  • Staffed Cash & FX Teller Windows 1–3 (`teller_window_1_3`): Large cash deposits/withdrawals, foreign currency cash notes, passbook servicing, and above-quota overseas tuition wires (Window 3 is the Senior & Accessibility Priority Counter).
  • Corporate Counter Window 4 (`corporate_window_4`): Business account opening, corporate drafts/checks, and treasury settlement.
  • South Hall VIP Wealth Lounge (`vip_wealth_lounge`): Dedicated CFP advisory suites and priority teller service for Cymbal Gold/Private clients (AUM ≥ $75,000 / RMB 500k).
  • West Hall Loan Advisory Desk (`loan_advisory_desk`): Residential mortgages, early mortgage payoff, personal credit lines, and SME business loans.

documents.title: Featured Wealth Management Shelf, Benchmark Yields & First-Time Risk Profiling

documents.title: Restoring Suspended Non-Counter Digital Transfers & Anti-Scam Safety Checklist
documents.location: Central Reception Pre-Check (`lobby_reception`) -> Teller Windows 1–3
documents.summary: If mobile banking displays 'Non-Counter Outbound Transfers Paused', bring your original ID, debit card, mobile-carrier ownership page, and recent legitimate transaction proof (payslip, lease, or contract) to `lobby_reception` for a quick document pre-check before lifting controls at Windows 1–3. Remember: authorities NEVER ask you to wire funds to a 'safe account' or share your screen.
documents.content:
[Lifting Protective Account Controls & Anti-Fraud Protection]
1. Why Controls Trigger: Protective non-counter pauses typically result from >6 months of account dormancy, an expired ID on file, or automated anti-fraud shielding triggered by unusual rapid pass-through transfers (in-person teller access with ID remains unaffected).
2. Required Restoration Documents: Please bring in person: (1) original government ID, (2) physical debit card, (3) mobile carrier app screen showing phone-number registration under your name, and (4) recent legitimate cash-flow documentation (payroll slip, lease, or purchase invoice). Stop by `lobby_reception` first so the Lobby Manager can pre-verify your documents before fast-tracking you to Windows 1–3.
3. Anti-Fraud Golden Rules: Law enforcement and regulators NEVER operate 'safe verification accounts'; never enable screen-sharing with unknown callers or transfer funds under secrecy instructions.
